description: Evaluate a trained RL policy with Isaac Lab (Isaac-Cartpole-Direct, 100 envs, 50 episodes).
inputInstructions: Run this against an asset holding a trained policy (.pt or .pth). The "Isaac Lab task" field must match the task the policy was trained on, "RL library" must match the library that trained it, and "Physics engine" should match the engine that trained it (a checkpoint from an earlier VAMS release was trained on isaacsim_physx). "Parallel environments", "Episodes" and "Steps per episode" size the rollout. Set "Record rollout video" to write a video of the rollout to the asset. Leave "Checkpoint path" blank to use the checkpoint of the chosen library found on the asset, or set it to a path within the asset to select one.

tagSchema.label: Isaac Lab task
tagSchema.description: The Isaac Lab task id to evaluate, for example Isaac-Cartpole-Direct. It must match the task the policy was trained on.

tagSchema.label: Parallel environments
tagSchema.description: How many environments are simulated in parallel during the rollout.

tagSchema.label: Episodes
tagSchema.description: How many episodes to roll out. The reported statistics are averaged over them.

tagSchema.label: Steps per episode
tagSchema.description: The maximum number of simulation steps in one episode, which bounds how long a rollout can run.

tagSchema.label: Record rollout video
tagSchema.description: Write a video of the rollout to the asset alongside the evaluation results.

tagSchema.label: RL library
tagSchema.description: The reinforcement-learning library whose Isaac Lab evaluation script runs. It must match the library that trained the policy, because a checkpoint is loadable only by the library that wrote it.

tagSchema.label: Physics engine
tagSchema.description: The physics engine for the run: newton_mjwarp (Newton, the default) or isaacsim_physx (PhysX on Isaac Sim, the engine earlier VAMS releases used). Results differ between engines, so evaluate a policy on the engine that trained it, or treat the evaluation as a transfer test; a checkpoint trained on the other engine is noted in the run log. Not every task offers both; a task that does not offer the chosen engine fails at the start and names the options.

tagSchema.label: Checkpoint path
tagSchema.description: A path to the policy file within the asset, for example checkpoints/<executionId>/model_300.pt for a checkpoint a training run wrote. Leave it blank to evaluate the highest-numbered checkpoint in the run folder written most recently.
